title: fix(app-shell): the package sheet's Adopt loose items asks in-app, reports the server's count, and each action clears the last message (objectui#13339)
body:
Closes #13339
Clause-②: no

## What changed

Setup → Packages, a package's sheet (`PackageDetailSheet` in `PackagesPage.tsx`):

- **Adopt loose items asks in-app.** The button opens the sheet's own `AlertDialog` from `@object-ui/components` (`pkg-detail-adopt-dialog`), in the idiom the sheet's Discard dialog already uses: a title naming the package, a description, Cancel, and an Adopt confirm. `window.confirm` is gone. Cancel sends nothing; only the confirm sends `POST /api/v1/packages/ID/adopt-orphans`.
- **It reports the server's count.** The adopt door answers `ReassignOrphanedMetadataResponse` (`@objectstack/spec/api`: `success`, `reassignedCount`, `reassigned`, `targetPackageId`), read at the pinned objectstack (`reassignOrphanedMetadata` in metadata-protocol, served by the runtime packages domain under the success envelope). The sheet now says "N items adopted into this base." from `reassignedCount`, with a One / Other pair for 1, and 0 included. No client-side count. The producer's own `success` is false exactly when nothing moved (it is true only for a non-empty `reassigned`); on this door that is a count of 0, so it is reported as "0 items adopted", not as a failure.
- **Starting any sheet action clears the previous message.** The actions that run straight away already cleared it (`run`, delete, duplicate, adopt). The ones that first open a dialog or a form did not, which is how a Revert refusal stayed under the Duplicate form. A small `startAction` helper now clears the message at the press that opens Duplicate, Delete app, Discard changes, Adopt loose items, Edit and View info.
- **Strings, en and zh** (`i18n.ts`): `engine.packages.detail.adoptConfirm` and `engine.packages.detail.adopted` retire. In their place: `adoptTitle`, `adoptDescription`, and the `adoptedOne` / `adoptedOther` pair. zh carries the same row for both plural forms, as the file's other pairs do.
- One changeset: `.changeset/13339-adopt-loose-items-confirm.md` (`@object-ui/app-shell` patch).

## Tests

New: `PackagesPage.adoptLooseItems-13339.test.tsx`, 13 tests, run through the real `PackageDetailSheet` with the fetch stub recording every request:
- the dialog opens and names the package, `window.confirm` is never called, and nothing is sent before the confirm; Cancel sends nothing; the confirm sends exactly one POST and closes the dialog;
- the message reports the answer's `reassignedCount`: 3 items, 0 items (where the answer's own `success` is false), and "1 item";
- a Revert refusal is gone once each of Duplicate, Delete app, Adopt loose items, Discard changes, View info or Edit is pressed, and an Adopt count is gone once Duplicate is pressed.

Results at head `0b1beecb3`:
- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` over every `PackagesPage*` test file (14) plus `product-neutral-renderer.ratchet.test.ts`: Test Files 15 passed (15), Tests 150 passed (150).
- `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192 pnpm exec turbo run type-check --concurrency=2 --filter=@object-ui/app-shell`: exit 0, Tasks 30 successful, 30 total (its `type-check` runs `tsc --noEmit` and `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`).
- `pnpm check:i18n-keys`, `pnpm check:i18n-drift`, `pnpm check:i18n-dead-keys`, `pnpm check:i18n-designer-parity`: each exit 0; the dead-keys report names no adopt key; designer parity: every en row has a zh row with the same placeholders.
- `eslint` on the three touched source and test files: 0 errors; the 15 warnings are all on lines this diff does not change.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: passes, 1 changeset declared. `pnpm check:new-line-citations`: 0 new citations.
- No test outside this page reads the changed strings (searched for the retired keys and the old sentence).

**Ablation** (fix committed first, each leg restored from `HEAD` and verified by a blob-hash match):
- Both source files back to the base commit: 12 of the 13 new tests fail. The one that stays green is "a Revert refusal is gone once Adopt loose items is pressed": the old native confirm, answered OK by the spy, runs the adoption, and that clears the message.
- Count leg (`reassignedCount` replaced by a constant 3): the 0 and the 1 tests fail.
- Clearing leg (`startAction` no longer clears the message): all 7 message-clearing tests fail.

## Acceptance notes

- The count is read as the spec declares it (`reassignedCount`, required). There is no fallback to `reassigned.length` or any other client-side count.
- The adopt call's catch still ends with its existing literal `'Adopt failed'` fallback. This diff does not touch it.

- [x] Adds no product-specific widget, dialog, hook or string (see AGENTS.md › Product-neutral renderer)
